releaseNotes: Improved Commit Graph readability with P/R node labels and real H/B/T reference badges tied to actual commits.
Bound HEAD and current branch data directly from repository snapshots to avoid guessed graph labels.
Added graph layout validation for dangling segments, lane continuity, missing parent edges and unloaded-parent continuation markers.
Optimized Commit Graph validation for large histories and updated graph column sizing so reference badges do not overlap or get clipped.
